types.name: chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressRequest
types.doc:
CreateDepositAddressRequest creates or returns the deposit address for one
 selected account target and chain.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc: PolyChain-registered source chain id to assign the deposit address for.

types.name: chain.deposit.v1.CreateDepositAddressResponse
types.doc:
CreateDepositAddressResponse returns the assigned deposit address for the
 requested target and chain.

fields.name: deposit_address
fields.doc: Assigned deposit address for the requested target and chain.

types.name: chain.deposit.v1.DepositAddress
types.doc: DepositAddress describes one assigned deposit address for one external chain.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc: PolyChain-registered source chain id used across deposit flows.

fields.name: deposit_address
fields.doc: Assigned external-chain deposit address for the selected account target.

types.name: chain.deposit.v1.ListDepositAddressesRequest
types.doc:
ListDepositAddressesRequest lists known deposit addresses for one selected
 account target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc:
Optional PolyChain-registered source chain id filter. When omitted, the
 response returns all known deposit addresses for the selected target,
 ordered by ascending chain id.

types.name: chain.deposit.v1.ListDepositAddressesResponse
types.doc:
ListDepositAddressesResponse returns the known deposit addresses for the
 selected target, ordered by ascending chain id.

fields.name: deposit_addresses
fields.doc: Known deposit addresses for the selected target.
